parameters.content:
## Gated Client Intake (Phase 2 Demo)

**Pattern:** Webhook → Validate → Stage → Interpret → (staged | replay | conflict | refused) → Respond → STOP

- This graph stages a fictional intake and creates a PENDING review — nothing more.
- It contains NO CRM node and NO CRM-capable edge: no path from this graph can attempt a CRM write.
- Queueing a review is NOT approval. A separate reviewer action (approve/reject) recorded outside this graph is required before any delivery workflow may run.
- Urgency is recorded as data only — urgency never bypasses review.
- Idempotency: the graph computes the canonical payload hash in-graph (inline SHA-256 over the six normalized delivery-relevant fields) and forwards it with the stable intake key. Exact replay of key + hash returns the ORIGINAL review with zero new writes; the same key with changed canonical content fails closed with a truthful 409 conflict. A duplicate is never approval.
- All requests and responses stay on the internal Docker network at http://mock-api:9090 with fictional Greenfield & Associates data only.

## Validation Rules

- Requires: X-Intake-Idempotency-Key header (stable caller key), first_name, last_name, at least one of email/phone, case type, description
- Reads the payload from the pinned n8n webhook envelope (`body`), with a flat-read fallback
- Phone normalized to E.164; nulls/empty strings stripped
- The canonical payload hash is computed over the NORMALIZED fields exactly as staged — order-invariant, content-sensitive
- Invalid submissions get a 400 response immediately and are never staged; staged-intake refusals (non-fictional data, hash mismatch) surface their own status codes truthfully
